[quote=nordiheim;59342469]The four Nordiheimians approaches the Gunya that has the masked man at its entrance, with Tau in the front, they give thanks for the welcome and graciously accept the invitation.

[i]I feal like I am not wrong in assuming that you elders are the council of Alkiragunya that we have heard about[/i]
He motions to his 3 companions in turn as they each gives a respectfull greeting to the council [i]These are my companions Olaf, Trym and Djalu[/i]
Tau then gives a greeting of his own [i]And I are Tau, we are travelers from the nation of Nordiheim that have traveled far to meet you, to talk about the potential of trade between our peoples, but also to broaden our understanding of your people as we have realiced that we actualy know less about your people and your ways then we feel we should[/i][/quote]
Os anciões viraram-se para Tau e os outros.
[i]Você  está correto em assumir isso, jovem, Ngarrajin já lhe deu boas vindas creio eu.[/i]
[b]O ancião aponta para o homem mascarado[/b], ele apenas os encara, seus olhos escuros parecem observadores  e atentos a tudo que eles dizem.
Ele continua.
[i]O conselho é composto por 12 membros dos clãs mais influentes em Alkiragunya, eu me chamo Balunji, líder do clã Gadoorbuya, o maior clã em Alkiragunya.
[/i]
Outro Ancião diz.
[i]Eu sou Tjarrampa, do clã Marrapinti, meu clã tem influência sobre o comércio de sal em Alkiragunya, mas se você quer realmente alguém para falar sobre comér-[/i]
O sujeito mascarado caminha interrompendo Tjarrampa, que sente um calafrio ao ser interrompido, Ngarrajin sussurra algo inaudível para os estrangeiros, que faz Tjarrampa ficar em silêncio.
[i]Em questões de acordos e diplomacia, eu viajei por tempo demais nesses desertos e sei bem de qualquer mínimo detalhe dessas terras e povo.[/i]
The elders turned to Tau and the others.

[i]You are correct in assuming that, young man, Ngarrajin has already welcomed you I believe.[/i]

[b]The elder points to the masked man[/b], he just stares at them, his dark eyes seem observant and attentive to everything they say.

He continues.

[i]The council is composed of 12 members of the most influential clans in Alkiragunya, my name is Balunji, leader of the Gadoorbuya clan, the largest clan in Alkiragunya.[/i]

Another elder soon star speaking .

[i]I am Tjarrampa, of the Marrapinti clan, my clan has influence over the salt trade in Alkiragunya, but if you really want someone to talk about trade-[/i]

The masked man walks interrupting Tjarrampa, who feels a chill at being interrupted, Ngarrajin whispers something inaudible to the foreigners, which makes Tjarrampa fall silent.

[i]In matters of agreements and diplomacy, I have traveled too long in these deserts and am well aware of every single detail of these lands and people.[/i]
